headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 28, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, and the Toronto Blue Jays edged the Baltimore Orioles in a thrilling 2-1 win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jose Quintana, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow sprain, and Garrett Whitlock, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list with left knee inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Lazaro Estrada, Lenyn Sosa, Kenley Jansen, Enrique Hernández, Nolan Schanuel, and Gavin Lux.

The Detroit Tigers made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies also made a trade, sending LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the Twins' offense with 3 RBI. Davis Martin earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Jose Quintana Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-hander Jose Quintana has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow sprain. This move comes after he was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
